---
title: "Album Cover Similarity Comparator"
---

```{=html}
<div class="card p-3 shadow-sm mb-4">
  <h4>Compare Any Artist's Album Covers</h4>
  <p class="text-muted mb-3">
    Type an artist's name to fetch their albums from MusicBrainz, select one from the dropdown, and compare its color and shape similarity against their other albums.
  </p>

  <div class="row g-2 align-items-center mb-3">
    <div class="col-auto">
      <label for="artistInput" class="col-form-label fw-bold">Artist:</label>
    </div>
    <div class="col-sm-5 col-12">
      <input type="text" id="artistInput" class="form-control" placeholder="e.g. Taylor Swift, Radiohead, The Beatles" value="Taylor Swift">
    </div>
    <div class="col-auto">
      <button id="searchArtistBtn" class="btn btn-primary">Find Albums</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="statusAlert" class="alert alert-info py-2" style="display:none;"></div>

  <div id="selectorContainer" style="display:none;" class="mb-4">
    <label for="albumSelect" class="form-label fw-bold">Select an album to compare against the others:</label>
    <select id="albumSelect" class="form-select" style="max-width: 500px;"></select>
  </div>

  <div id="resultsArea" style="display:none;">
    <div class="row mb-4">
      <div class="col-md-4 text-center border-end">
        <h5 class="fw-bold">Selected Album</h5>
        <div id="selectedAlbumCard" class="card p-2 shadow-sm d-inline-block"></div>
      </div>
      <div class="col-md-8">
        <h5 class="fw-bold">Ranked by Visual Similarity</h5>
        <p class="text-muted small">Based on 16×16 downsampled color and layout similarity.</p>
        <div id="similarAlbumsList" class="row g-3"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  const artistInput = document.getElementById('artistInput');
  const searchBtn = document.getElementById('searchArtistBtn');
  const statusAlert = document.getElementById('statusAlert');
  const selectorContainer = document.getElementById('selectorContainer');
  const albumSelect = document.getElementById('albumSelect');
  const resultsArea = document.getElementById('resultsArea');
  const selectedAlbumCard = document.getElementById('selectedAlbumCard');
  const similarAlbumsList = document.getElementById('similarAlbumsList');

  let currentAlbums = [];
  const vectorCache = {};

  function setStatus(msg, type = 'info') {
    if (!msg) {
      statusAlert.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }
    statusAlert.className = `alert alert-${type} py-2`;
    statusAlert.textContent = msg;
    statusAlert.style.display = 'block';
  }

  function getPixelVector(url) {
    if (vectorCache[url]) {
      return Promise.resolve(vectorCache[url]);
    }
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const img = new Image();
      img.crossOrigin = "anonymous";
      img.onload = () => {
        try {
          const canvas = document.createElement("canvas");
          canvas.width = 16;
          canvas.height = 16;
          const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
          ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 16, 16);
          const data = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, 16, 16).data;
          const vec = [];
          for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i += 4) {
            vec.push(data[i] / 255, data[i+1] / 255, data[i+2] / 255);
          }
          vectorCache[url] = { img, vec };
          resolve({ img, vec });
        } catch (err) {
          reject(err);
        }
      };
      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Cover image unavailable"));
      img.src = url;
    });
  }

  function computeSimilarity(vecA, vecB) {
    let sum = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < vecA.length; i++) {
      sum += Math.abs(vecA[i] - vecB[i]);
    }
    const meanDiff = sum / vecA.length;
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Math.round((1.0 - meanDiff) * 1000) / 10));
  }

  async function searchArtist() {
    const query = artistInput.value.trim();
    if (!query) return;

    setStatus(`Searching MusicBrainz for "${query}"...`, 'info');
    selectorContainer.style.display = 'none';
    resultsArea.style.display = 'none';
    albumSelect.innerHTML = '';
    currentAlbums = [];

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/artist/?query=artist:${encodeURIComponent(query)}&fmt=json`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (!data.artists || data.artists.length === 0) {
        setStatus(`No artist found matching "${query}".`, 'warning');
        return;
      }

      const artist = data.artists[0];
      setStatus(`Found "${artist.name}". Fetching studio albums...`, 'info');

      const rgRes = await fetch(`https://musicbrainz.org/ws/2/release-group?artist=${artist.id}&type=album&limit=100&fmt=json`);
      const rgData = await rgRes.json();
      const rgs = rgData['release-groups'] || [];

      // Filter primary albums and remove live/remixes if possible
      const seenTitles = new Set();
      const albums = [];
      for (const rg of rgs) {
        const secTypes = rg['secondary-types'] || [];
        if (secTypes.includes('Live') || secTypes.includes('Remix') || secTypes.includes('Compilation')) {
          continue;
        }
        const titleKey = rg.title.toLowerCase();
        if (seenTitles.has(titleKey)) continue;
        seenTitles.add(titleKey);

        const year = rg['first-release-date'] ? rg['first-release-date'].substring(0, 4) : 'Unknown';
        albums.push({
          id: rg.id,
          title: rg.title,
          year: year,
          coverUrl: `https://coverartarchive.org/release-group/${rg.id}/front-250.jpg`
        });
      }

      albums.sort((a, b) => (a.year || '').localeCompare(b.year || ''));

      if (albums.length === 0) {
        setStatus(`No studio albums found for ${artist.name}.`, 'warning');
        return;
      }

      currentAlbums = albums;
      albumSelect.innerHTML = albums.map(a => `<option value="${a.id}">${a.title} (${a.year})</option>`).join('');
      selectorContainer.style.display = 'block';
      setStatus(`Loaded ${albums.length} albums for ${artist.name}. Select one below to compare!`, 'success');

      // Trigger comparison for initial selection
      compareSelected();
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      setStatus('Error loading data from MusicBrainz. Please try again in a moment.', 'danger');
    }
  }

  async function compareSelected() {
    const selectedId = albumSelect.value;
    const selected = currentAlbums.find(a => a.id === selectedId);
    if (!selected) return;

    setStatus(`Loading cover for "${selected.title}" and computing similarities...`, 'info');
    resultsArea.style.display = 'block';

    selectedAlbumCard.innerHTML = `
      <img src="${selected.coverUrl}" class="img-fluid rounded shadow-sm mb-2" style="max-width: 200px;" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/200x200?text=No+Cover'">
      <div class="fw-bold">${selected.title}</div>
      <div class="text-muted small">${selected.year}</div>
    `;

    let selectedVectorData;
    try {
      selectedVectorData = await getPixelVector(selected.coverUrl);
    } catch (err) {
      setStatus(`Could not load cover image for "${selected.title}". It might not have cover art archived.`, 'warning');
      similarAlbumsList.innerHTML = `<div class="col-12 text-muted">Cover image unavailable for comparison.</div>`;
      return;
    }

    similarAlbumsList.innerHTML = `<div class="col-12 text-muted">Comparing other covers...</div>`;

    const comparisons = [];
    const others = currentAlbums.filter(a => a.id !== selectedId);

    for (const other of others) {
      try {
        const otherData = await getPixelVector(other.coverUrl);
        const sim = computeSimilarity(selectedVectorData.vec, otherData.vec);
        comparisons.push({ album: other, similarity: sim, hasCover: true });
      } catch (err) {
        // Image not in archive
        comparisons.push({ album: other, similarity: -1, hasCover: false });
      }
    }

    comparisons.sort((a, b) => b.similarity - a.similarity);

    similarAlbumsList.innerHTML = comparisons.map(c => {
      const simText = c.hasCover ? `${c.similarity}% similar` : 'Cover unavailable';
      const badgeClass = c.similarity >= 80 ? 'bg-success' : (c.similarity >= 65 ? 'bg-primary' : (c.similarity >= 50 ? 'bg-warning text-dark' : 'bg-secondary'));
      return `
        <div class="col-sm-6 col-md-4">
          <div class="card h-100 p-2 shadow-sm text-center">
            <img src="${c.album.coverUrl}" class="img-fluid rounded mb-2 mx-auto" style="height: 140px; object-fit: cover;" onerror="this.src='https://placehold.co/140x140?text=No+Cover'">
            <div class="fw-bold small text-truncate" title="${c.album.title}">${c.album.title}</div>
            <div class="text-muted small mb-2">${c.album.year}</div>
            <div>
              <span class="badge ${badgeClass}">${simText}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    setStatus('');
  }

  searchBtn.addEventListener('click', searchArtist);
  artistInput.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') searchArtist();
  });
  albumSelect.addEventListener('change', compareSelected);

  // Auto-search default on load
  searchArtist();
})();
</script>
```


```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)

albums <- read_csv("data/albums.csv")
```

We downloaded album covers for Taylor Swift's studio albums from MusicBrainz.

```{r}
#| label: show-covers
#| output: asis

albums |>
  arrange(year) |>
  pwalk(\(album, year, mbid, file) {
    cat(sprintf("![%s (%s)](%s){width=150px} ", album, year, file))
  })
```

## Visual Similarity Analysis

To compare color and layout, each cover was downsampled to a 16×16 pixel grid to capture broad shapes and color distribution. We then calculated the visual similarity percentage between every pair of albums.

```{r}
#| label: plot-similarity
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 7

similarity <- read_csv("data/album_similarity.csv")

# Heatmap showing similarity between all pairs
ggplot(similarity, aes(x = album_1, y = album_2, fill = similarity_pct)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Similarity (%)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Album Cover Visual Similarity Heatmap",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  )
```

### Top 5 Most Similar Pairs

```{r}
#| label: top-pairs

similarity |>
  filter(album_1 < album_2) |>
  arrange(desc(similarity_pct)) |>
  select(Album_1 = album_1, Album_2 = album_2, `Similarity (%)` = similarity_pct) |>
  head(5)
```
